items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 204:1
items.html: In practice, the matter of the second restriction was made only in the Partzuf of the points of SAG of AK, which is clothed within the Partzuf of the TNHY of AK, from its Tabur and downward. And in it the concluding Malchut of this world ascended to the point of its Chazeh [chest], and it brought out the vessels from the Chazeh and downward to the aspect of an empty void, and they became the place for BYA. And likewise, all the matters that were renewed with the second restriction begin only from the Tabur of AK and downward. For every diminution begins to rule only from the place of its emergence and downward, and nothing [rules] above the place of its emergence.
